description: Appeal decisions linked to one UK planning application by stable id '{lpa_slug}:{app_ref}' (or lpa + lpa_app_no) — Planning Inspectorate (England), PEDW (Wales), DPEA (Scotland), PAC (Northern Ireland): each appeal's type, procedure, decision, date, and whether we hold the decision letter. Joins the application corpus to PINS on the LPA application reference, and adds appeals known from the decision letters councils published with their applications (decades older than the Inspectorate's five-year casework data; source=council_archive). Coverage states the span of appeals held for the LPA per source and the captured-letter fraction, and coverage_note says it in one sentence. 404 if the LPA is not in our roster; an empty list means no appeal linked to the application is on record (a recent one may not be yet).
